title: ActionRunner: drop the transitional `${…}` reading of a holeless confirmText / successMessage, now that objectstack refuses every other `${…}` in action copy (objectstack#25702)
body:
Filing gate **③, a follow-up owed by a landed change**: the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#25702 (ruling `6365736632` on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24814, the refusal half). Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT`. The seat committed to this card in its ACCEPT, and the contract review `6388655816` holds it to it. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's.

## What landed upstream

objectstack-ai/objectstack#25702 (merged `0c81694006`) makes the action copy pass refuse, as `error` at `validate`, `compile` and the publish gate, every `${…}` token in `confirmText` / `successMessage` **except one shape**:
- a sentence with **no** `{{ }}` hole whose `${…}` tokens all name `record.*` (`confirmText`) or `result.*` (`successMessage`).

That shape stays a **warning** (`ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS` in `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`) for one reason only: this runner still fills it. Measured at objectstack's pinned `.objectui-sha` `2958f17e9c`, and still true on `main` `a3c0da9227`:
- `packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:1839`: `confirmMessage` sends a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole to `templates.evaluate(text)`, the `${…}` reading. The docblock at `:1824` says it keeps "the transitional `${…}` reading … until the spec card converts it".
- `:1808`: `composeSuccessMessage` sends a holeless `successMessage` to `substituteScopeTokens(successCopy, { result: payload }, …)`.

## The ask

Remove both transitional branches, so a holeless sentence renders as written, the same as any other text with no `{{ }}` hole:
- `confirmMessage`: the `!hasTemplateHoles(text)` branch returns the text as written instead of evaluating it.
- `composeSuccessMessage`: the holeless `successMessage` returns `successCopy` as written instead of running `substituteScopeTokens`.
- Update both docblocks (`:161`, `:1824`) and their tests.

**Out of scope, do not touch:** `outcomeMessages` (`:1803`, `substituteScopeTokens` over `result`) and `errorMessage`. objectstack keeps both outside this family (contract review `6385469184`), and their `${result.*}` reading is not transitional.

## Why it is safe now

The upstream producer measurement through built `@objectstack/lint` at `6021b5e837` found 0 findings of any severity in action copy:
- `examples/**` (app-showcase, app-todo, app-crm, app-multi-package);
- `platform-objects` (12 `confirmText`, 48 `successMessage`);
- `plugin-approvals` (9 sentences);
- HotCRM `a4b3560` (20 sentences).

No in-tree producer authors the holeless `${…}` shape, so dropping the branch changes no copy anyone ships today. An author who writes it still gets the upstream warning, which tells them to use `{{ }}`.

## After this lands

A paired spec/lint card in objectstack-ai/objectstack, filed in the same stroke and pointing back here, waits for objectstack's `.objectui-sha` to carry this change. It then turns the remaining warning into an error and deletes `ACTION_COPY_DOLLAR_TRANSITION_ROOTS`, so the `${…}` reading ends on both sides.

## Dedupe

Semantic search in objectstack-ai/objectui, "ActionRunner confirmText successMessage ${record} dollar transitional fallback remove": 14 hits, all closed. The nearest are #13367 (the `{{ }}` renderer half of objectstack#24814, which introduced this branch as transitional), #12967 and #13154 (hole-filling defects). None removes the branch. **New.**
